app.lema: Real-time shade · Historic Center of Valledupar

idioma.cambiar: You can change it anytime in settings.

barra.utci: Estimated UTCI · in the sun {sol} · in the shade {sombra}

mapa.etiqueta: Shade map of the Historic Center of Valledupar
mapa.cargando: Loading the solar model of the center…
mapa.otraHora: See the shade at another time
mapa.provisionalDetalle: Some trees, heights and places are provisional until the field survey arrives.
mapa.ubicacionInsegura: This address isn't secure (https), so the browser won't share your location
mapa.simulacionDetalle: This is how the map looks with an overcast sky. Temperature and humidity come from the forecast; the cloud cover (90 %) and the lack of direct sun are simulated.

ficha.svfExplicacion: Share of the sky visible from the {orientacion} side: 0 means covered and 1 means open sky. It is the estimated average of the points on that sidewalk, with buildings and trees.
ficha.fenologiaCambia: The cañaguates on this segment drop their leaves from January to March: in that season this segment goes down to {estado}.
ficha.fenologiaIgual: The cañaguates on this segment drop their leaves from January to March; at this time the shade barely changes.
ficha.fenologiaSinHojas: The cañaguates on this segment are leafless this season; they give shade again with the rains.

pantallas.pendiente: This screen is built in Phase {fase}.
pantallas.enPausa: On hold by the author's decision.

guia.subtitulo: Visual system of the Isochronous Shade Map web app · Historic Center of Valledupar
guia.nota: Development page to compare with page 03 in Figma (node 44:41). Times, names and values are sample data, not calculated.

principios.legibleTexto: High contrast, 15 px minimum text and 60 px buttons. No light grays on white.
principios.izquierdaTexto: As in the symbol: deep green means protection; amber means exposure. The amber dot is the sun.
principios.colorTexto: Every state combines color, shape and text: circle, triangle, diamond, square; solid, dashed, dotted.
principios.honestoTexto: Every calculated value says "estimated" and shows its time. If there is no shade, the app says so.

color.texto: Each swatch is a token. The CSS name is the one the prototype code uses.

tipografia.texto: Inter for the whole interface; Archivo Black only in the logotype. One text style per role.
tipografia.muestraCuerpo: Walk on the west sidewalk for 380 m.
tipografia.muestraMicro: Estimated UTCI · in the sun 41° · in the shade 35°

iconografia.texto: Custom family: 42 icons on a 24 px grid.
iconografia.regla1: 24 × 24 px grid with 2 px inner margin.
iconografia.regla2: 2 px stroke, rounded caps and joins.
iconografia.regla3: Only "Full shade" and "Partial shade" use fill: they echo the logic of the symbol.
iconografia.regla4: Sizes: 20 px on markers, 24 px in lists, 28 px in alerts.
iconografia.regla5: On a colored background, the icon takes that level's text color.
iconografia.componentesTexto: 24 px grid · 2 px stroke · rounded caps and joins · base/text color (changed per instance).

semaforo.texto: Four decision levels, plus a neutral state for cloudy skies. Provisional thresholds based on UTCI categories.
semaforo.no_recomendado: Very strong heat stress or El Niño

mapa.texto: The base map is warm and muted so the segments stand out. Segments and markers are components.

componentes.tarjetaEsperarTexto: The best calculated time for this route
componentes.tarjetaTransporteTexto: To the shaded point closest to the route
componentes.hojaTexto: Full shade until 1:20 p.m. · west sidewalk
componentes.modalTexto: Between 11 a.m. and 3 p.m. the sun is strongest. This route has 62% shade.
componentes.modalAlternativa: See the best time to leave

espaciado.radios: Radii: control 12 px · card 16 px · sheet 24 px · chip 20 px. Minimum touch area 56 px.

pwa.texto: Adaptive version: the symbol stays inside the safe zone (80% circle), because Android crops the edge. The final files are generated in Phase 9.

sombra.texto: Phase 3: calculated in the browser from public/datos. All values are estimates.
sombra.cargando: Loading the solar model of the center…
sombra.sinSol: No sun at this time: the sun is below the horizon.
sombra.elegirTramo: Choose a segment in shade at this time
sombra.ninguno: No named segment is in full shade at this time.
sombra.noPlena: Not in full shade at this time
sombra.perfil: Daily profile: % of shade from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

pantallas.texto: App routes. For now almost all are empty: each one shows the phase in which it is built.

simulador.texto: Force the weather to test the five states of the top bar. These values are simulated, not taken from the forecast.
simulador.ganancia: Solar gain: +{v} °C of mean radiant temperature
simulador.fueraDeRango: These conditions are outside the range of the UTCI model.

nublado.titulo: It's cloudy: shade matters less right now
nublado.cubiertos: We show you covered places nearby.

elNino.texto: IDEAM reports El Niño conditions in Cesar. Highs are above the historical average and solar radiation is stronger than usual.
elNino.rutas: Routes favor continuous shade even if they are a little longer.
elNino.hidratacion: Water and rest points in the center are highlighted.
elNino.aviso: Between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM you will see a warning before starting any walk.
elNino.ejemplo: Example view: El Niño is not active today according to the app settings.

referencia.texto: The temperature chip becomes a decision. Each level has its own shape, not just a color.
referencia.ejemplo: Example values from Figma (node 32:154); the level comes from the app rules.

niveles.comodo: Level 1 · Continuous shade or a cool strip. Normal route.
niveles.precaucion: Level 2 · Short stretches in the sun (under 3 min). Bring water.
niveles.evitar: Level 3 · Long stretches in the sun between 10 AM and 3 PM. Suggests another time or transport.
niveles.no_recomendado: Level 4 · Very strong stress or El Niño active. Walking this trip is not recommended.

referencia.nota: Provisional thresholds based on the UTCI categories; they will be calibrated with field measurements.

origen.puntoElegido: the point chosen on the map
origen.fueraDelCentro: Your location is outside the historic center: choose a point on the map.
origen.elegirTitulo: Tap the map to choose the starting point
origen.elegirFuera: Choose a point inside the historic center.

rutas.unaSola: the shortest is already the shadiest
rutas.cuandoSalir: When is it best to leave?
rutas.sinRuta: We couldn't find a route between these points.
rutas.fueraDelArea: {destino} is outside the shade map, {distancia} from Alfonso López Square. There are no shaded routes there yet.
rutas.destinoDesconocido: That destination doesn't exist or has no location yet.

cuando.grafico: Minutes in the sun by departure time
cuando.siSalesAhora: If you leave now: about {n} min in direct sun
cuando.sinClima: No weather data: the bars show minutes in the sun, without a level.

sinRuta.titulo: There's no shaded route at this time
sinRuta.esperarTexto: From {laHora}, {p} % of the way is in the shade.
sinRuta.esperarNo: There is no time with less sun for this route today.
sinRuta.transporteTitulo: Take transport part of the way
sinRuta.transporteTexto: Take a taxi to {lugar} and walk {n} min in the shade.
sinRuta.transporteDestino: Take a taxi to {lugar} and skip the walk in the sun.
sinRuta.transporteRefugio: Take a taxi to {lugar}, a shaded place near your destination.
sinRuta.transporteNo: There is no shaded final stretch or shelter near the destination.
sinRuta.protegerseVarios: Sunscreen, water and a hat. There are {n} rest points along the way.
sinRuta.protegerseUno: Sunscreen, water and a hat. There is 1 rest point along the way.
sinRuta.protegerseCero: Sunscreen, water and a hat. No rest points are recorded along the way.

isocronas.boton: Isochrones: walking minutes in the shade
isocronas.tocar: Tap the map to choose where from.
isocronas.nota: Minutes in the sun count more, so the bands follow the shade.

avisoCalor.titulo: It's the hottest time of day
avisoCalor.texto: Between {desde} and {hasta} the sun is at its strongest. This route is {p} % in the shade, with about {n} min in direct sun.
avisoCalor.textoSinSol: Between {desde} and {hasta} the sun is at its strongest. This route is {p} % in the shade.
avisoCalor.mejorHora: See the best time to leave
avisoCalor.ejemplo: Example view with sample values. In the app, this warning appears when you start a walk between {desde} and {hasta}.

proteccion.texto: This route has about {n} min in direct sun.
proteccion.gorra: Wear a cap or carry an umbrella
proteccion.nota: General advice; it does not replace the advice of a health professional.
proteccion.ejemplo: Example view with sample values. In the app, this sheet appears when you start a walk with {min} min or more in the sun and a UV index of {uv} or more.

recorrido.avisoExpuesto: In {distancia} you cross an exposed stretch
recorrido.enExpuesto: You are on an exposed stretch
recorrido.sinSombra: {largo} without shade · about {tiempo} in direct sun
recorrido.progreso: {distancia} · {p} % of the way in the shade
recorrido.simulacionNota: The dot moves along the route on its own, {x} times faster than walking, with the shade at {laHora}
recorrido.gpsTitulo: Your location is needed to follow your progress
recorrido.gpsTexto: It is used only on this phone, and your walk is not saved.
recorrido.denegada: There is no permission to use your location. You can turn it on in your browser settings or use simulation mode.
recorrido.insegura: This test address can't use GPS because it isn't secure (https). Use simulation mode.
recorrido.noDisponible: No GPS signal. You can wait or use simulation mode.
recorrido.lejos: You are {distancia} from the route. Go to the starting point or use simulation mode.
recorrido.destinoDesconocido: There is no route to show. Choose a destination first.

llegada.nota: Your answers help validate the prototype. They are saved only on this phone.
llegada.gracias: Thank you. Your answer was saved on this phone.
llegada.ejemplo: Example view with sample values: finish a walk to open this screen.

refugios.alSolAhora: In the sun at this time
refugios.sinDatos: There are no places to rest registered yet.

inicio.cargando: Loading the solar model of the center…
inicio.error: We couldn't load the center's data.

permiso.texto: We use your location and your phone's time to work out which sidewalk is in the shade right now. We don't save your route.

fuera.texto: Umbral calculates shade only inside the center. You can explore it from here or get directions to it.
fuera.consejo: If you arrive between {desde} and {hasta}, take a taxi to Alfonso López Square and walk from there in the shade.
fuera.esquema: Diagram: you are {distancia} from the Historic Center.
